title: 第11章 职业学院
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
“才两个小时……你想让我有多大进步？我能在三天里，让‘骨刺’的冷却时间从62秒，缩减到58秒，已经是极大地进步了好吧？”关立远无奈的说道。
而这时只见魏樱樱打了个响指，一副粉色阵图凭空浮现之后，一团半米直径的粉色云气冲出，将“演武场”旁作为目标的一块五十斤的石锁撞的侧翻……
“这是‘云元素使’入门技能中的‘云冲击’，和你的‘骨刺’一个等级，贯穿力不如‘骨刺’，不过纯粹力量要更大些、瞄准难度更小些……我现在使用‘云冲击’的冷却是6.2秒。”魏樱樱决定刺激一下关立远。
“好吧，我一定也会努力追回这差距的，不过……”
“不过你需要时间……哎，这个我和秋也知道，所以我们才着急！还有四天，我们就要去城郊的杜兰职业学院，进行为期一年的职业者统一培训了，不能在一年内将三种技能全部衍生到低阶的程度，就必须接受联盟的安排，进行三年的卫戍训练……难道你不想我们一起组队吗？”
虽然“杜兰职业学院”的名字，总是令关立远觉得，这是个学挖掘机的地方，不过实际上却是杜兰城唯一的联盟直属、专门为入门阶的职业者，提供训练的学院，属于强制性入学，钟离家也不能破坏这规矩……
“不要！”
这不是关立远说的，而是一旁的钟离秋。
关立远闻言不由得诧异的看了过去，只见钟离秋说道：“如果立远要被卫戍训练三年的话，我就等三年再出发历练！我一定要和樱樱姐还有立远一起组队！”
钟离秋的任性脾气又上来了，而关立远在头疼的同时，也有些感动……
这个世界从千年前开始，就在被来自“深渊”的生物侵略着，昔日人类称霸的大陆，现在已经只有三分之一，还有人类的城邦存在……
当然，按照企鹅的说法，深渊也好、这个位面也好，都是同一个世界中的不同部分。
不过因为位面本身，也有“自保性”的法则存在，一开始的时候，深渊生物在这个位面会被大幅削弱，但与此同时，只要深渊生物长期盘踞，位面的自保规则也会被侵蚀！
因此从北方在千年前深渊出现的“裂缝”，到南方人类联盟据守六十余座城市占据的最后乐土，深渊生物的分部整体上很有规律……
“乐土”内的城市中，城内几乎是安全的，城郊偶尔有弱小的深渊生物出现，城市之间的野地，就已经有不少深渊生物存在，只是并不强……
而越是向北方，越是有强大的深渊生物存在！
普通人可以龟缩在“乐土”的城市中，但是职业者必须主动出击，因为如果不进行干扰的话，深渊生物将在短时间内，将整个大陆的位面规则，全部改造成适合他们生存的状态，那人类就离灭绝不远了……
千年前，深渊裂缝刚刚出现的时候，人类就差点灭绝，不过“天无绝人之路”的是，古代职业者们发现，深渊生物虽然强大、残暴，但是却也有“好处”，那就杀死深渊生物之后，可以为职业符文的提供能量积累！
古代职业者们，需要依靠冥想等等手段，才能够为符文积累进阶能量，而杀戮深渊魔物，则将这一过程大幅缩短了。
虽然突破位阶依旧困难，但职业者的成长速度依旧被大幅催化，加上“模拟试炼”的技术渐渐发达，觉醒的几率由不到千分之一、渐渐提升到了现在的百分之三……这才令人类还能够守住最后的“乐土”！

因此职业者们，通常会在渡过了入门阶段，达到低阶之后，就自发的组队开始历练，一方面提升自己，另一方面也是阻扰深渊生物的侵略……
当然，也有一部分职业者，会加入联盟的卫戍队，以军团的形式，抵御深渊生物的进攻！
两者都十分重要，自由职业者组成的小队，因为目标小，可以四处削弱深渊生物的力量、延缓位面侵蚀。
而联盟卫戍队的作用，则是抵御有组织的深渊生物的集体性进攻。
但是因为基层卫戍队会收到很大的约束，而且在卫戍队中，个人成长的速度会比自由职业者更慢，所以在低阶时很少有职业者愿意进入卫戍队，反而不少已经达到高阶的自由职业者，会选择转而加入卫戍队。

content_en:
"It's only been two hours... How much improvement do you want me to make? I can reduce the cooldown time of the 'Bone Spur' from 62 seconds to 58 seconds in three days. Is that a huge improvement?" Guan Liyuan said helplessly.
At this moment, Wei Yingying snapped her fingers, and after a pink formation appeared out of thin air, a pink cloud with a diameter of half a meter rushed out, knocking over a fifty-pound stone lock next to the "Martial Arts Arena" as the target...
"This is the 'Cloud Impact' in the introductory skill of the 'Cloud Elementalist'. It is the same level as your 'Bone Spur'. The penetrating power is not as good as the 'Bone Spur', but the pure power is greater and the aim is less difficult... The cooldown of my current use of 'Cloud Impact' is 6.2 seconds." Wei Yingying decided to stimulate Guan Liyuan.
"Okay, I will definitely try to make up for this gap, but..."
"But you need time... Hey, Qiu and I also know this, so we are anxious! In four days, we will go to the Dulan Vocational College on the outskirts of the city for a year of unified professional training. If we cannot derive all three skills to a low-level level within one year, we must accept the arrangement of the alliance and conduct three years of garrison training... Don't you want us to form a team together?"
Although the name "Dulan Vocational College" always makes Guan Liyuan think that this is a place to learn excavators, in fact it is the only college directly affiliated with the alliance in Dulan City that specifically provides training for entry-level professionals. Admission is compulsory, and the Zhongli family cannot break this rule...
"No!"
This was not said by Guan Liyuan, but by Zhong Liqiu on the side.
When Guan Liyuan heard this, he couldn't help but looked over in surprise, and saw Zhong Liqiu saying: "If Liyuan is going to be trained by the garrison for three years, I will wait for three years before setting off for training! I must form a team with Sister Yingying and Liyuan!"
Zhong Liqiu's willful temper came back, and while Guan Liyuan had a headache, he was also a little moved...
This world has been invaded by creatures from the "abyss" since thousands of years ago. Now only one-third of the continent that humans once dominated has human city-states existing...
Of course, according to Penguin, both the abyss and this plane are different parts of the same world.
However, because the plane itself also has the rules of "self-preservation", at the beginning, the abyssal creatures will be greatly weakened in this plane, but at the same time, as long as the abyssal creatures stay here for a long time, the self-preservation rules of the plane will also be eroded!
Therefore, from the "cracks" that appeared in the abyss thousands of years ago in the north to the last paradise occupied by the human alliance in the south, which is occupied by more than 60 cities, the divisions of abyssal creatures are generally very regular...
In the cities in the "Promised Land", the city is almost safe. Weak abyssal creatures occasionally appear on the outskirts of the city. There are already many abyssal creatures in the wilderness between the cities, but they are not strong...
And the further north you go, the more powerful abyss creatures exist!
Ordinary people can huddle in the cities of "Promised Land", but professionals must take the initiative, because if there is no interference, the abyssal creatures will transform all the plane rules of the entire continent into a state suitable for their survival in a short period of time, and then human beings will not be far from extinction...
Thousands of years ago, when the cracks in the abyss first appeared, humankind was almost extinct. However, "there is no way out". Ancient professionals discovered that although the abyssal creatures are powerful and cruel, they also have "benefits". After killing the abyssal creatures, they can provide energy accumulation for professional runes!
Ancient professionals needed to rely on meditation and other methods to accumulate advanced energy for runes, but killing abyss monsters greatly shortened this process.
Although it is still difficult to break through the ranks, the growth rate of professionals is still greatly catalyzed, and the technology of "simulation trial" is gradually developed.Da, the probability of awakening has gradually increased from less than one thousandth to the current three percent... Only then can mankind still hold on to the final "promised land"!
Therefore, professionals usually form teams spontaneously and start training after passing the entry stage and reaching low levels. On the one hand, they can improve themselves, and on the other hand, they can also thwart the invasion of abyssal creatures...
Of course, there are also some professionals who will join the alliance's garrison to form a legion to resist the attacks of abyssal creatures!
Both are very important. A team composed of freelancers, because the target is small, can weaken the power of abyssal creatures and delay the erosion of the plane.
The role of the alliance garrison is to resist the collective attack of organized abyss creatures.
However, because the grassroots garrison will be under great constraints, and in the garrison, the speed of personal growth will be slower than that of freelancers, so few professionals are willing to join the garrison at low levels. On the contrary, many freelancers who have reached high levels will choose to join the garrison instead.
